title: feat: add context7.json so Context7 serves current Pollinations docs
author: danhquach

gist.summary: Added a schema-validated context7.json that scopes Context7 indexing to public Pollinations guides, API docs, SDK, MCP, and polli CLI documentation, excluding apps, operations, internal services, tests, and contributor-only files. Its six agent rules point to gen.pollinations.ai, Bearer keys from enter.pollinations.ai/keys, live model listings, and the hosted MCP endpoint at gen.pollinations.ai/mcp/pollinations; they also say to keep sk_ keys server-side. A fork indexing test returned no retired npx @pollinations/mcp snippets or internal-doc snippets for an MCP setup query. Existing documentation content is unchanged.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny librarian glasses; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements—never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and lavender tones and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
